content: दैशिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [देशेन निर्वृत्तं तस्येदं वा-ठञ्] .²1 Local, provincial. .²2 National, belonging to the whole country. .²3 Belonging or having reference to space; <ls>Bhāṣā P. 120</ls>. .²4 Acquainted with any place. .²5 Teaching, pointing, directing, showing. .{@-कः@} .²1 A teacher, preceptor; शुको गतः परित्यज्य पितरं मोक्षदैशिकम् <ls>Mb. 12. 321. 94</ls>. .²2 A guide. .²3 One instructed by the preceptor; <ls>Bhāg. 11. 27. 22</ls>. .²4 Local people; हस्तिनोऽश्वा रथाः पत्तिर्नावो विष्टिस्तथैव च . दैशिकाश्चाविकाश्चैव तदष्टाङ्गं बलं स्मृतम् <ls>Mb. 12. 121. 44</ls>. .{@-कम्@} a kind of dance; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Me. 37</ls>; <ls>Malli.</ls> <ab>Com.</ab>
